blocks.text: COTABATO CITY – Former Sultan Kudarat Rep. Arnulfo Go, who was charged for alleged malversation of public funds and corruption, voluntarily surrendered to police authorities in General Santos City on Sunday, Brig. Gen. Alan Manibog, Police Regional Office-12 director, confirmed Monday. “He voluntarily and peacefully surrendered to us on Sunday and we have turned him over to the Sandiganbayan today (Nov.9),” told the Inquirer by phone. Manibog said Go, a businessman from Lebak, Sultan Kudarat, surrendered to police units from Sultan Kudarat province and General Santos City along Mabuhay Road, Barangay San Isidro.
